description: A package re-export is reached through imports even though its call alias is unresolved.

expected_affected.tests/test_export.py::test_export: shop.price re-exports shop.core.price, so the test reads the changed return.

expected_unaffected.tests/test_control.py::test_control: Calls only unchanged control.healthy in an independent subsystem.

limitations: The re-export chain is not resolved into a precise test-to-function call. Module/import fallback selects the affected test in this case, so there is no selection discrepancy.
